summary: Full backend + UI testing of the new Manage Admins feature. All backend endpoints (GET /api/admin/users, PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}) behave correctly: admin-only (403 for members), self-demotion blocked (400 with correct detail), unknown id 404, and promote/demote round-trip persists. UI: /admin has new 'ADMINS' tab (admin-tab-admins) which renders manage-admins with admin-users-table, admin-count ('1 admin · 13 members'), admin-user-search (filter by email verified), self row shows '(you)' and no toggle button, other rows show Make admin / Remove admin via toggle-admin-<id>. Promoting member@shenanigators.com flips button to 'Remove admin', shows admin-badge-<id>, and letting member log in grants /admin access (ManageAdmins viewable). Demoting removes badge, flips button, and member next sees admin-denied. All 7 admin tabs (events/trips/posts/rsvps/inquiries/submissions/admins) load without errors. Member left as NON-admin at end as instructed.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py admin_list_users: clean projection excludes _id and password; good. is_you flag added server-side so UI doesn't need to compare ids - nice design.
server.py admin_set_user_role: self-demotion guard correctly compares target_id to acting user_id; 404 vs 400 distinction is correct.
ManageAdmins.js uses window.confirm (per spec) and reloads list via useFetch's reload after mutation - state syncs correctly in the UI (verified).

DB contains 10+ leftover TEST_*@example.com users from older iterations' test_account_mgmt / test_auth_flows runs - those tests do not clean up. Not related to this feature, but worth adding a teardown fixture to prefix-delete TEST_ users after suite.
test_credentials: admin@shenanigators.com / AdminPass123!, member@shenanigators.com / MemberPass123 (member left as non-admin at end)
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing admin + member accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_manage_admins.py reuses Bearer auth pattern (Authorization header). Member is non-admin at end. Admin list currently returns ~13 users including many TEST_*@example.com leftovers from previous test iterations.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Feature fully meets acceptance criteria.
